lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Arranged in vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. High-luminance circular clusters show a transition from small, densely packed points near the gills to larger, more widely spaced blobs progressing posteriorly along the lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a discernible grid-like pattern across the mid-flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature is visible across the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient featuring high-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge and a shadow-cast gradient on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The primary visible pectoral fin exhibits a high-contrast pattern of densely packed, small-diameter high-luminance spots across its dorsal surface.
